feed.title: NPR Topics: Science
feed.subtitle: The latest health and science news. Updates on medicine, healthy living, nutrition, drugs, diet, and advances in science and technology. Subscribe to the Health & Science podcast.

entry.title: Senators question Trump's picks for top health positions, including surgeon general
entry.summary: On Wednesday, the Senate committee on health holds a confirmation hearing for three top health officials, including surgeon general. Dr. Nicole Saphier is President Trump's third attempt to nominate a surgeon general.

entry.title: U.S. acknowledges for the first time that it has deployed weapons in space
entry.summary: The remarkable revelation comes after previous warnings about countries such as Russia possibly weaponizing a global frontier long agreed in treaties to be used for only peaceful purposes.

entry.title: Tiny krill are turning up in deep-sea hydrothermal vents. Scientists want to know why
entry.summary: Antarctic krill serve as a crucial food source for penguins, seals, and whales. They recycle nutrients used by algae. Now researchers say they've found krill in a surprising place: hydrothermal vents.

entry.title: NASA rushed engineers out of their labs. They say it risks future space missions
entry.summary: NASA employees say they've lost vital equipment and staff needed to make sophisticated spacecraft amid the agency's abrupt relocations over the past several months.

entry.title: Trump's EPA repeals pollution limits on fossil fuel power plants
entry.summary: The Trump administration is eliminating limits on climate-warming pollution from the nation's fossil fuel power plants. Environmental groups say this will impact the climate and public health.

entry.title: New Carlo Rovelli book challenges science's understanding of reality and the universe
entry.summary: In his latest book, the world-renowned physicist draws on science and philosophy to explore the notion that the university and reality are fully knowable.

entry.title: Pennsylvania says an unvaccinated woman has died from measles-related complications
entry.summary: Pennsylvania has announced its third measles-related death in less than three weeks. A local coroner says the 40-year-old woman was unvaccinated.

entry.title: Actor Tatyana Ali is advocating for Black and Indigenous maternal health
entry.summary: Actor Tatyana Ali says her healing journey after a traumatic childbirth has inspired her advocacy for Black maternal health, including support for midwives, doulas and other birth workers.

entry.title: This summer was hot. August shattered global heat records
entry.summary: Scientists say that August was the hottest month ever recorded globally. In the U.S., summer temperatures also shattered heat records.

entry.title: A fossil feather from the age of dinosaurs may explain why only some birds survived
entry.summary: An extremely well preserved fossil feather could reveal why some birds survived the dinosaur-killing asteroid, and others did not.
